package migrated

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"
)

func foldExpression() http.Registration {
	profile := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer)))
	return profile.Handle(handler)
}

func foldReassign() http.Registration {
	secured := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(editor)))
	// the rule is declared below
	return secured.Handle(handler)
}

func foldNested() http.Registration {
	return http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Permissions(viewer))).Handle(handler)
}

func foldKeepsActors() http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer)))
	e = http.ConfigureAuthenticated(e, http.ActorMiddleware[User](audit))
	return e.Handle(handler)
}

func foldMerges() http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer)))
	return e.Handle(handler)
}

func foldAnyOf() http.Registration {
	e := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AnyOf(http.AllOf(http.Permissions(viewer)), http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read))))
	return e.Handle(handler)
}

func foldInList() []http.Registration {
	a := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(read)))
	b := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, http.AllOf(http.Scopes(write), http.Permissions(editor)))
	return []http.Registration{
		a.Handle(handler),
		b.Handle(handler),
	}
}
